speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent; since you are a newborn, I will be speaking with your parent or guardian to understand your symptoms. Can you tell me how long your baby has been showing signs of illness and what specific changes you are noticing?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis. The history of no prenatal care and unavailable immunization records is a major risk factor. Given the newborn status and lack of maternal screening, I suspect Group B Streptococcus or E. coli sepsis. I will proceed with blood cultures and a CBC to confirm. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count and Blood_Culture.
